physics: A rich negative-gap exit should usually be accepted, unless the held-side probability is extreme enough that the exit is likely clipping a near-certain winner. This keeps the v2 loss guard while testing whether v1-only high-p recoveries are durable.
rule: Suppress value-over-hold exits when p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00; or when p_hold >= 0.85 and fair_drawdown_cents >= -5.0; or when p_hold >= 0.95 even if book gap is slightly negative. Suppress probability_reduce exits only when p_hold >= 0.79 and p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00. Keep collapse exits unchanged.
strict_forward_note: Only post-v3-freeze rows count for promotion.
